title: AUCSeg: AUC-oriented Pixel-level Long-tail Semantic Segmentation
mechanism: Pixel-level AUC (ranking) loss with a tail-class memory bank so each batch contains tail pixels.
adaptation: Threshold-free ranking suits crack (bias tuned anyway) and splice; memory bank stores small crops of splice, inactive, edge_dark, material pixels.
min_experiment: Arm: AUC loss + T-memory bank added to CE+Dice, 3 seeds; baseline SUP100; metric mIoU_rob, splice IoU, crack AP; kill if mIoU_rob < +0.01.
evidence: R: tail-class gains on Cityscapes, ADE20K, COCO-Stuff 164K.
